name: Nathalie Loiseau - Après le § 4 - Am 9
title: REPORT on EU-Syria political relations
part_text: 4a. Insists that EU budget support and reconstruction funding for the Syrian authorities be conditional on effective cooperation on the return and readmission of Syrian nationals who have no right to remain in the Member States; calls for such funding to be suspended if the Syrian authorities refuse to cooperate;
